from collections import Counter
from pathlib import Path

def transform(grid):
    counts = Counter(v for row in grid for v in row)
    background = counts.most_common(1)[0][0]
    keep = {color for color, count in counts.items() if color != background and count >= 8}
    return [[v if v in keep else background for v in row] for row in grid]
